headline: Meeting alerts you won't miss
subtitle: MeetingGuard AI reminds you before every meeting, in the way you choose.

alerts.title: Alerts that get your attention
alerts.body: Choose how you are reminded: an alarm (full screen while MeetingGuard is open, a high-priority alarm notification when it is closed), a banner that stays until you act, or a gentle reminder. With sound and vibration; spoken alerts play while the app is open.

calendars.title: Your calendars, together
calendars.body: Sync with Google Calendar and bring in events from the calendars on your phone.

assistant.title: An AI assistant that asks first
assistant.body: Create, move or share meetings by typing what you need. Nothing changes until you confirm it.

languages.title: English and Spanish
languages.body: Use the app, the alerts and the assistant in either language.
